list.label: Gemini 3.8 Flash
list.source: Google's models page (https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models, updated 2026-09-24): gemini-3.8-flash, stable, "our most intelligent Flash model"; its OpenAI compatibility examples use gemini-3.8-flash. Thinking levels low, medium (default), high (https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/thinking; reasoning_effort on the OpenAI compatibility endpoint, https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/openai); thinking can't be turned off on Gemini 3 models. errorMap.notes: Gemini's OpenAI compatibility layer (https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/openai, updated 2026-09-02) answers Chat Completions at /v1beta/openai with the key as a Bearer token; errors come as [{error: {code, message, status}}]. A bad key is a 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT whose message says 'API key not valid', never a 401; an unsupported country is a 400 FAILED_PRECONDITION, 'User location is not supported'. A 403 PERMISSION_DENIED is a key without the Generative Language API (a good key, the wrong project), not a rejected one. Gemini 3 models can't turn reasoning off; reasoning_effort maps to their thinking level. UNVERIFIED against a live key.

privacy.retention: Paid tier: logged 55 days for abuse monitoring, not used to improve products; the free tier's content may be used to improve Google's products and seen by human reviewers
privacy.trains: Paid tier: no. Free tier: yes
privacy.zdr: Not on the Gemini API (Vertex AI only)
privacy.notes: The Gemini API Additional Terms (https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms) require users to be 18 or older and say the API is for professional or business use; in the EEA, Switzerland and the UK only Paid Services may be used. The app can't tell a free key from a paid one.

player.short: Keeps messages up to 55 days; may train on them before billing.
player.keeps: Kept up to 55 days to check for abuse. Until you set up billing, people at Google may read your messages.
player.trains: Not once you set up billing. Until then, your messages may be used to improve Google’s products.
